verse.verse_3: And when the mountains are made to pass away;
verse.verse_4: And when the pregnant she-camels are neglected;
verse.verse_5: And when the wild beasts are gathered together.
verse.verse_6: And when the seas become as blazing fire.
verse.verse_7: And when the souls are joined with their mates.
verse.verse_8: And when the female infant (Al-Maw'udah) buried alive is questioned (Su'ilat):
verse.verse_9: For what sin was she killed
verse.verse_10: And when the pages are laid open.
verse.verse_11: And when the heaven is Kushitat;
verse.verse_13: And when Paradise is brought near.
verse.verse_14: Every person will know what he has brought.
verse.verse_15: But nay! I swear by Al-Khunnas.
verse.verse_17: And by the night when it `As`as.
verse.verse_18: And by the day when it Tanaffas.
verse.verse_19: Verily, this is the Word a most honorable messenger.
verse.verse_20: Dhi Quwwah, with the Lord of the Throne -- Makin,
verse.verse_22: And your companion is not a madman.
verse.verse_23: And indeed he saw him in the clear horizon.
verse.verse_24: And he withholds not a knowledge of the Unseen.
verse.verse_25: And it is not the word of the outcast Shaytan.
verse.verse_27: Verily, this is no less than a Reminder for the creatures.
verse.verse_28: To whomsoever among you who wills to walk straight.
verse.verse_29: And you cannot will unless that Allah wills -- the Lord of all that exists.
